cards.card_text: Then the backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, like me sneaking spoonfuls of dough all afternoon and wondering why I'm too stuffed to taste-test the batch.
cards.verse_text: The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, but a good man is rewarded for his ways.
